Name: No Mine Flyers Redux
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Removes the Fly monsters in the mines
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Per a request from [Keileon](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/22130454), removes the Fly monsters from the mines!  The Grubs will still spawn and attempt to transform, but despawn when hatching from the cocoons.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!
Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it.

3.  Copy  the 'NoMineFlyersRedux' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Known Issues

*   The fly sprite shows up for a split second as the cocoon hatches.
